articles.title: How European investors can now buy bitcoin without taking on U.S. dollar risk
articles.snippet: Asset management platform HANetf has listed ETCs in London, Frankfurt and Paris providing pound sterling and euro-hedged exposure to bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs stretch $3.1B inflow streak as Ether funds turn red
articles.snippet: Ether ETFs shed $3 million Tuesday after seven days of inflows, following an $8 million outflow from Zcash funds at the start of the week.
